title: Notebook
description: One paper notebook, page by page, in scan order.

id.description: Unique slug; matches the file name without .json and the scans/<id>/ folder.

status.description: Whether the notebook is still being written in.

scan.description: How scripts/split-notebook.mjs turns each scanned spread into two pages.

rotate.description: Clockwise degrees that make the spread upright.

split.description: Where the fold sits, as a fraction of the upright spread's width, for spreads whose fold can't be found.

front_cover.description: The outside front cover, scanned on its own to scans/<id>/cover-front.jpg. Absent until it's scanned.

open.description: Waiting to be rescanned now that the notebook is complete.

sections.description: The parts this notebook is expected to have, in order (front cover, title page, table of contents, scales, session pages, index, notebook info, ...). Scanned pages are matched to them in order; a section with nothing scanned yet isn't shown.

pages.description: Every scanned page in order; the nth entry is scans/<id>/<nn>.jpg.

kind.description: What its pages are. A session section also holds unused and blank pages. front_cover is the outside front cover, scanned on its own (see front_cover).

label.description: Its name, e.g. 'Front cover'. Pages with a label must carry the same one.

pages.description: How many pages it has. Defaults to 1, or to as many as it needs for session pages and the index.

hidden_until_complete.description: Left off the site while the notebook is in progress.

rescan.description: Rescanned when the notebook is completed; Complete notebook checks it was.

number.description: Page number: printed on odd pages, inferred for even ones. Front matter has none.

open.description: Still being written in. Re-read on the next import; hidden on the site (except session pages) until the notebook is completed.

redact.description: Boxes to blur before publishing, as [x, y, width, height] fractions of the page.
